data.name: Help_Text
data.value:
PowerToys Light Switch Control the running Light Switch service. Enable Light Switch in PowerToys first.
Usage: PowerToys.LightSwitch.CLI.exe <command> [options]
Commands: status Show the current themes and scheduling state. light Apply the light theme to the configured targets. dark Apply the dark theme to the configured targets. toggle Toggle the configured theme targets. schedule enable [--mode MODE] Enable scheduling, optionally selecting a mode. schedule disable Disable scheduling.
Schedule modes: fixed-hours, sunset-to-sunrise, follow-night-light
Options: --json Write one JSON object, including errors. -h, --help Show help without contacting the service. --version Show the CLI version without contacting the service.
JSON command output uses the service response envelope: version, success, state or error. JSON help/version output is local: version, success, and help or cliVersion.
data.comment: CLI help, also returned in the JSON help field. Translate headings and descriptions. Do not translate PowerToys.LightSwitch.CLI.exe, command names (status, light, dark, toggle, schedule, enable, disable), options (--mode, --json, -h, --help, --version), mode values (fixed-hours, sunset-to-sunrise, follow-night-light), or JSON keys (version, success, state, error, help, cliVersion). Keep the example syntax and line breaks.

data.name: Description_Root
data.value: Control the running PowerToys Light Switch service.

data.name: Description_Mode
data.comment: Do not translate the literal mode values fixed-hours, sunset-to-sunrise, or follow-night-light.

data.name: Error_UnknownScheduleMode
data.value: Unknown schedule mode. Use fixed-hours, sunset-to-sunrise, or follow-night-light.
data.comment: Do not translate the literal mode values fixed-hours, sunset-to-sunrise, or follow-night-light.

data.name: Error_CommandRequired
data.value: Specify a command. The schedule command requires enable or disable.
data.comment: schedule, enable, and disable are literal command names and must not be translated.

data.name: Error_TimedOut
data.value: The request timed out or was cancelled. It may already have taken effect; run status before trying again.
data.comment: status is a literal command name and must not be translated. Preserve the warning that the command may already have taken effect.

data.name: Error_UnexpectedFailure
data.value: The Light Switch command could not be completed. See the Light Switch log for details.

data.name: Error_RequestTooLarge
data.value: The Light Switch request exceeds the protocol limits.

data.name: Error_UntrustedServer
data.value: The pipe is not owned by this installation's Light Switch service.

data.name: Error_ServiceUnavailable
data.value: Light Switch is not available. Enable it in PowerToys and try again.

data.name: Error_ConnectionClosed
data.value: The connection closed before a complete response arrived. The command may already have taken effect; run status before trying again.
data.comment: status is a literal command name and must not be translated. Preserve the warning that the command may already have taken effect.

data.name: Error_InvalidUtf16
data.value: Light Switch returned invalid UTF-16 data.
data.comment: UTF-16 is an encoding name and must not be translated.

data.name: Error_ResponseTooLarge
data.value: The Light Switch response exceeds the protocol limit.

data.name: Error_InvalidResponse
data.value: Light Switch returned an invalid or incompatible response.

data.name: Hint_Usage
